page-parsed.eventDescription: One successfully parsed source page: $5 per 1,000 pages. This fee applies even when filters, duplicates, exclusions or monitoring leave no delivered rows. Failed requests and unrecognized responses are not charged. Separate delivered-video fee applies. No start fee; proxy and compute included. Work stops before a new page when maxTotalChargeUsd cannot cover a page plus one row.

video.eventDescription: One delivered video row: $1 per 1,000 rows. Row keys: id, video_id, title, url, channel_id, views, duration_seconds, published_text, thumbnail_url. Filtered, duplicate, unchanged and excluded rows have no row fee. Parsed pages are billed separately at $0.005 each, even with zero rows. No start fee; proxy and compute included. maxTotalChargeUsd is an Apify run option, not actor input.
